label: EXAMPLE — NOT A RESULT. ALLOCATION — NO EDGE CLAIMED; NOT DSR-GATED. Preregistration only; contains no performance figure.
n_family_note: one configuration (N = 1); two permitted starts: the research-window report, then the full-history report only after spec 058 T016 (D-8)
holdout: never opens spec 058's sealed holdout (sessions >= 2023-10-02) before spec 058 T016

common.bars: daily close-to-close; research on the spec 035 validated unadjusted cache, PAPER on Alpaca raw SIP bars (D-9)
common.entry: a sleeve enters on its first full session after listing plus 60 observed sessions
common.asset_vol: EWMA of daily log returns, span 60 sessions, rows <= t only
common.weights: raw w_i proportional to 1 / sigma_i over held sleeves, normalized to sum 1
common.portfolio_vol: 60-session EWMA covariance at t, annualized over 252 sessions
common.scaling: all weights scaled by min(1, portfolio_vol_target_annual / sigma_p)
common.cash: the remainder after scaling is cash
common.rebalance: first session of each calendar month
common.execution: decision at close t, fill at open t+1; positions held between decisions (no daily re-targeting)
common.data_hole: D-6: any undefined EWMA variance or pairwise covariance at t makes the whole book cash for that month; sleeves are never dropped
common.costs: spec 046 model only: half of the EDGE full-spread estimate (bidask v2.1.0 algorithm) plus square-root impact Y=1.0, 21-session windows
common.cost_model_version: EDGE per bidask 2.1.0 reference algorithm (return de-meaning included)

configurations.rule: spec 059 §3 as stated in common; no free parameter

baselines.rule: equal weight of every sleeve with a close at t, same calendar and costs
D-7: each sleeve long or flat with probability 1/2 per decision row, then the same §3 sizing and 046 costs, at least two seeds

report.statistic: PSR at this family's own N = 1
report.label: ALLOCATION — NO EDGE CLAIMED; NOT DSR-GATED

voiding: any change to these values after a 058 or 059 result is seen voids spec 059 D-1; a change needs a new spec number and preregistration
